lines.en: My hooves ride the wind.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇一下，我升高一点
lines.en: One wingbeat lifts me higher.
My mane streams in the airflow.
I pass above the treetops.

lines.zh: 蹄子落在空中，没有声音
lines.en: My hooves land on air, silently.
I keep low, so as not to alarm anyone.
I descend in a wide circle.
My white feathers shine in the light.
I toss my head and my mane sweeps my shoulder.
I glide forward along the current.
My wingspan is wider than my body.
I skim low across the plains.

lines.zh: 我拐弯的时候翅膀会倾
lines.en: My wings bank when I turn.
I land on the slope with a heavy hoof.
I stand with wings half open.
Wind pulls my mane back.
I am studying the ground below.
My hoof scrapes the soil.
Dust scatters from between my white feathers
Sun bleaches my feathers white.
I raise my head toward the wind.

lines.zh: 我背上的鞍带系得很紧
lines.en: The girth on my back is cinched tight.
The air here is clean.

lines.zh: 我呼出的气在风里变白
lines.en: My breath whitens in the wind
I lift one hoof.
My wingtip touches the ground.
I am waiting for you to be ready.
The saddle on my back is empty.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，鬃毛垂下来
lines.en: I lower my head, mane falling forward.
I lower my head and sniff your hair
I could carry you a stretch.
Can you get up?
My wings rise far above you.

lines.zh: 你把手放在我的鬃毛上
lines.en: You put a hand in my mane.
Next time the wind blows, I will know
Get a grip before you move.
Are you afraid of heights?
The seat on my back is steady.
Let me walk a circle so you can see.
Sit down, and I take off.
You rest a hand on the saddle.
I can fly you out of here.
I will try to keep still.
I can bear your weight.
I cry out and give half a step.
A feather came loose.
One of my wings is trembling
I land, hooves sinking.
That knocked me askew.
My wings are whole, so I can still lift off
Blood mats my mane.
Hooves sink into the soil and I stand firm
My body is not the sturdiest.
I have noted where you stand.
That smells sweet.
Set it down first.
I will eat after the flight.
A little grass is enough for me.
Hold it lower.
Smells like grass, is it food
I come close at a slow trot.
Chewing, my eyes never leave you
An apple would be better.
Step back half a pace, do not startle me
Give this one to me first.
Once I eat, I will have strength.
I fold my wings and steady.
What you hit was my breastbone

lines.zh: 我退了半步，蹄子陷进土
lines.en: Half a step back, hoof sinking in.
My wingtip brushes your face.
That tipped me sideways.
One collision and white feathers fall.
I settle my footing again.
Do not come at me from behind.
Two pits are left where I stood.
I move away slowly.

lines.zh: 我飞起来更容易被看到
lines.en: In flight I am easier to see.
My mane is combed smooth.

lines.zh: 我们一起飞过这片平原
lines.en: We could fly over these plains together.
It is best when the wind is strong.
I do not fight; I stand on the slope.
I land on the higher slope.
We circle the same ring.
My wings could carry us both.
Will you ride with me?
Slowly, now.
Held in my mouth, lifted high
This is not very heavy.
One flick of the hoof and it rolls aside
It rolled down the slope.
I drop it into the bag by the saddle.
Too light to hold beneath my hoof
It does not smell of grass, so I leave it
I pry it out with my mouth
I have to bend my neck low.
Taking it does no harm.
I hear something below.
First I climb a little.
The wind here helps me.
I see clearly from above.
You cannot outrun me.
I need not land to strike.
Your bearing is under my hoof.
This open ground cannot hide you
I have dropped lower.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候我已经到了
lines.en: By the time you look up, I am there.
My hooves can kick too.
I am patient; I wait.
I drop lower and follow you

lines.zh: 你往哪边走我都看得见
lines.en: I see whichever way you go.
I have the dive angle worked out.
The wind covers the sound of me.
I make another half circle.
My shadow falls across yours.
There are no trees that way.
My wings are slowly folding.
The beat of my wings is behind your ear.
I descend a little more.
You will not want to run twice.
The way behind you is narrow.
I dive out of the sunlight
My hooves strike your shoulder.
A wing sweeps across your face.
That one carried the wind's force.
I butt you with my head.
You are driven back again.
That one slid past.
I pull up and come back around.
My hooves are hard.
You did not dodge, so I hold nothing back
My wings tilt and I strike at you
I did not use my full force.
Four hooves land, kicking up dust
My wings fold at my sides.
The wind here suits me.

lines.zh: 我先绕着平原飞了一圈
lines.en: First I circled the plains.
My mane is blown awry.
There is a village in the distance.
I land on the crest.
My hooves press the soil firm.
The clouds are low here.
My mane swings to the other side of my neck
Cloud damp still clings to my mane.
My hooves leave two marks.
First I took my bearings.
This is higher than I expected.
Fire scorches my wingtips.
I fall straight down from high.

lines.zh: 水让我的翅膀变得很沉
lines.en: Water makes my wings heavy.

lines.zh: 冲击把我从空中掀下来
lines.en: The blast knocks me out of the air.
An arrow stays under my wing root.
That force numbs my wings.
Hunger makes me lurch in flight.
Lightning strikes my wing.

lines.zh: 这里没有风可以托住我
lines.en: There is no wind here to hold me.
